title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.13202v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. translated_title: S$^3$R：基于自稀疏推测解码的快速且忠实的强化学习轨迹生成
translated_abstract: 针对带可验证奖励的长上下文强化学习（RLVR），快速生成rollout需要在不改变用于策略优化的响应组的前提下减少KV缓存流量。在我们分析的RLVR工作负载中，注意力计算占自回归解码内核时间的72–76%。稀疏注意力可以减少这些读取，但直接从稀疏策略中采样会改变用于学习的响应组。对于组相对优化，我们证明即使采用精确的响应级重加权，通常也无法恢复期望的稠密策略更新，因为每个响应的优势取决于组内其他成员的奖励。我们提出了自稀疏推测轨迹生成（S$^3$R）：它使用稀疏注意力起草token，然后通过全注意力验证和精确推测采样生成响应。起草与验证共享同一策略参数，从而无需训练或更新单独的……
tldr: S³R提出自稀疏推测解码方法，用稀疏注意力起草token、全注意力验证并采用精确推测采样，在严格保持稠密策略采样分布（保证训练忠实性）的同时大幅加速长上下文RLVR的rollout生成。
en_tdlr: S³R introduces a self-sparse speculative decoding approach that drafts tokens with sparse attention and verifies them via full attention with exact speculative sampling, faithfully preserving the dense-policy sampling distribution while substantially accelerating rollout generation for long-context RLVR.
